app.name: makemecookies! x4
app.long_description:
A kitsch cookie factory you tend five stations of at once. Flour into the hopper, dough out of the mixer, along the belt, golden out of the oven, boxed and shipped — and none of the five machines waits for you.
A round is exactly one play of Jimmi's "makemecookies! x4", and the track ending is the end-of-shift whistle. There is no losing: only how much you shipped, and how much mess you left behind.
Hold the Wiimote sideways. Left, Up and Down work the hopper, the mixer and the conveyor; 1 and 2 work the oven and packing.
Built with magnolia, a Wii homebrew game engine by magmacrunch.
